description: Na₂Mg(CoO₂)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.35 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.83 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.13 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.12 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and three Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two equivalent Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Mg, and two Co atoms to form distorted ONaMg₂Co₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₄Co₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ONaMg₂Co₂ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-81°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted ONa₄Co₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄Co₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONaMg₂Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Co₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°.
